_README: Copy to appsettings.Production.json next to MatterFlow.Api.dll on the server and replace every REPLACE_* value. Keys starting with an underscore are comments and are ignored. No secrets belong here: both connection strings use Windows integrated security. See docs/runbook.md section 2.
AllowedHosts: REPLACE_WITH_SITE_HOST_NAME (for example matterflow.firm.local; several names separated by semicolons; no scheme, no port)

ConnectionStrings._MatterFlow: Used by the running site. The app pool identity must be a member of the database role mf_app (DML + EXECUTE, no DDL, audit table INSERT/SELECT only). In Production the API refuses to start if this identity can UPDATE, DELETE or ALTER dbo.AuditEvent.
ConnectionStrings._Migrations: Used only by schema scripts (migrate-only, or startup if Migrations:Enabled is true). The login needs DDL (member of mf_migrator or a DBA). Integrated security means: the Windows account that runs migrate-only. Never reuse the application login.

Bootstrap._SystemAdmins: Accounts that become System Admin at their first sign-in (applied once per user). DOMAIN\sam, case-insensitive.

ActiveDirectory._LookupEnabled: Optional display-name/email lookup at first sign-in using the app pool identity. Leave false until IT confirms that identity can read Active Directory.

StarterConfiguration._Enabled: Optional starter data (task types, workflows, forms, priorities). Idempotent and never overwrites admin edits. Off by default outside Development.

Migrations._Enabled: false: schema changes are applied by the deployment step 'dotnet MatterFlow.Api.dll --migrate-only' (docs/runbook.md section 7), so the site's DML-only identity never needs DDL. Set true to also migrate at startup.

Hosting._ServeSpa: The Angular build in wwwroot is served automatically when wwwroot/index.html exists. Set false to run the API alone.
